CustomField.description: Plain Number field manually populated with a copy of Actual_Upgrade_Week_Number__c's value. Exists because that formula field is flagged non-groupable by the platform; this field lets the Pro-Active Pipeline dashboard filter/query on the exact same value without that restriction. Populated and kept up to date manually - no automation writes to this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Manually maintained copy of Actual Upgrade Week Number, for dashboard use. Do not rely on this being automatically kept in sync.
